title: Teamleiter Last Mile Logistik (m/w/d)
description: <h2>Kurz und Knapp</h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Du liebst die tägliche Abwechslung, siehst dich als (zukünftige) Führungskraft, um dein Team zum Erfolg zu führen, und bist bereit für eine neue Herausforderung in der Logistik?<br><br>Dann bist du bei Picnic genau richtig! Denn wir suchen nach einer Teamleitung für unseren Last Mile Standort (Hub) in <strong>Erding</strong>. Die Hubs werden mit unseren bereits fertig kommissionierten Waren aus dem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) beliefert und sind als Verteilzentrum die letzte Station unserer Logistikkette, bevor die Einkäufe beim Kunden auf dem Küchentisch landen.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Sei von Anfang an dabei: Unser Hub in Erding hat gerade erst Mitte März eröffnet – du hast also die Chance, den Standort aktiv mitzugestalten und zu prägen.</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span data-rich-links="{&quot;fple-t&quot;:&quot;Teamleiter Last Mile Logistik bei Picnic&quot;,&quot;fple-u&quot;:&quot;https://youtu.be/gUawd1tvF1Q&quot;,&quot;fple-mt&quot;:null,&quot;type&quot;:&quot;first-party-link&quot;}"><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/gUawd1tvF1Q" width="560" height="314"></iframe></span><br><br></p> <h2><strong>Das erwartet dich&nbsp;<br></strong></h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Teamführung:</strong> Stelle dein Team ein und coache es zum Erfolg. Du kannst auch tolle Events planen, um den Zusammenhalt weiter zu stärken.</li> <li><strong>Entwicklung zur Führungskraft:</strong> Du managst nicht nur die Schichtpläne, sondern übernimmst die Einarbeitung und Entwicklung der Runner (Fahrer) in einem unserer Hubs, und sorgst so dafür, dass alles rund läuft.</li> <li><strong>Liefermanagement: </strong>Du übernimmst die Verantwortung, wenn die Lkw mit frischen Waren ankommen, und sorgst dafür, dass alles passt! Und wenn etwas fehlt, organisierst du blitzschnell Nachlieferungen – du behältst immer den Überblick über doe Logistik in deinem Standort.</li> <li><strong>Prozessmanagement:</strong> Du hältst den Betrieb am Laufen durch einen kontinuierlich den Fokus auf unsere betrieblichen Kennzahlen (KPIs) und garantierst, dass alles sicher und wie am Schnürchen läuft, ganz nach unserem Motto: “Safety First”.</li> <li><strong>Teamwork:</strong> Im engen Austausch mit dem Customer-Success Team, unserem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) und anderen Hubs machst du unsere Kunden glücklich.</li> <li><strong>Pünktliche Abfahrten:</strong> Dank dir sind unsere Fahrer immer pünktlich unterwegs zu unseren Kunden, damit wir unser versprochenes Zeitfenster einhalten können.</li> <li><strong>Bringe deine Ideen ein</strong>: Von der Koordination der Reparatur unserer Elektrofahrzeuge über die Gestaltung des Hub Layouts bis hin zur Rekrutierung unserer Runner - deine Ideen tragen dazu bei, dass wir gemeinsam weiter wachsen können&nbsp;und unsere Logistikprozesse auf ein neues Level bringen.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Das bringst du mit&nbsp;</h2> <ul> <li>Ein Studium oder abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung in der Logistik, dem Einzelhandel oder in ähnlichen Bereichen.&nbsp;</li> <li>Erste Erfahrungen in der Führung von Teams - entweder im Beruf oder du hast bereits ein anderes Erfolgsteam gecoached.</li> <li>Fließende Deutsch- und basic Englischkenntnisse.</li> <li>Du bist im Besitz eines gültigen Führerscheins der Klasse B.</li> <li>Gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten und ein selbstbewusstes Auftreten.</li> <li>Du magst es, Entscheidungen auf Grundlage von Zahlen und Fakten zu treffen.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Darauf kannst du dich freuen</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Starte durch - mit uns: </strong>Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.</li> <li><strong>Nachhaltigkeit als Kern:</strong> Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.</li> <li><strong>Die Basics:</strong> Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.</li> <li><strong>Zeit zum Auftanken: </strong>Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.</li> <li><strong>Verpflegung für Gewinner: </strong>Wir kümmern uns um dich. In unseren Hubs steht dir jederzeit ein gut gefüllter Kühlschrank mit frischen Snacks, Getränken und Obst zur Verfügung – damit du bestens versorgt bist, wenn dich der Hunger packt.</li> <li><strong>Unvergessliche Momente:</strong> Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.</li> <li><strong>Individuelle Mobilität:</strong> Du entscheidest, wie du zu uns kommst. Wir bieten ein subventioniertes Deutschlandticket und ein „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm an.</li> <li><strong>Lerne &amp; wachse:</strong> Profitiere von internen Lern- &amp; Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bereit für die Herausforderung? Dann bewirb dich, werde Teil des Picnic Teams und hilf uns dabei, zum besten Milchmann in Deutschland zu werden!</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

With offices in New York, London, Berlin, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $189M from Goldman Sachs Growth Equity, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com . About the Role Taktile builds AI products for the world's most complex decisions and we hold ourselves to the same standard internally. We believe the companies that win the next decade will be the ones that turn AI from a tool into a multiplier - embedded into how every team works. We're looking for an AI Enablement Lead to make this the reality at Taktile. This is a high-leverage, internal-facing operations role: you won't be building features for our customers, you'll be building the tools, integrations, and workflows that make every Taktilian faster and better at their job. You'll be the first hire dedicated to this mission, working closely with team leads across the company to identify, build, and scale the AI workflows with the biggest impact. You'll be taking over a program that was set up internally and comes with support for infrastructure and agent-building. You will operate at both strategic and hands-on levels: setting the roadmap and reporting directly to leadership, while also building workflows and running enablement yourself. Taktile is a hybrid company. This role requires working at least 3 days per week from one of our offices in Berlin, Iasi, or London. What You'll Do Strategy & Roadmap Define and own Taktile's internal AI roadmap, prioritize use cases across Go-to-market, Operations, and G&A Track market trends, peer practices, regulatory evolution, and emerging tools — stay on the frontier, know when new tools and models release, which ones are worth experimenting with, and bring the best back into the business Continuously evaluate and improve our setup to maximize adoption and improve efficiency of our teams Report to leadership on progress, AI adoption, and program ROI Set the internal standard for "production-ready" AI workflows and act as the escalation point and quality bar for everything our teams ship Define a build vs. buy framework for AI point solutions - assessing, approving, or deprecating tools in close collaboration with our teams Agentic Workflow Development Build internal tools and agents end-to-end that wire Taktile's SaaS stack (HubSpot, Notion, Linear, Gong) into our engineers' and operators' daily workflows. Own scope, design, implementation, rollout, and iteration. Evolve AI architecture based on internal customer needs and tangible, measurable improvements. Identify, prioritize, and scale automation opportunities across business units, while clearly differentiating what can and should be automated and to what degree vs. what should not (yet) Find the highest-leverage workflows. Embed with teams across Engineering, GTM, Customer Success, Finance, and Operations to identify where AI can remove the most friction. Build team-level ownership and coordinate a network of AI champions so workflows are maintained without central dependency Capability Building & governance Drive adoption, not just deployment. Run hands-on workshops, pair sessions, and office hours to teach teams how to actually use what you ship. Measure success in real adoption and time saved, not features delivered. raw.title: AI Operations Lead
raw.description:
About Taktile

Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI-native organizations that are increasingly powered by autonomous agents. With our modular Agentic Decision Platform, customers combine AI agents, rules, relevant context, and human oversight to safely automate and optimize their decisions — approving more customers, reimbursing claims instantly, and financing every business worth funding.

Founded in 2020, Taktile powers millions of decisions daily for institutions including Mercury, Monzo, Faire, and Pleo. With offices in New York, London, Berlin, São Paulo, and Iași, the company has raised $189M from Goldman Sachs Growth Equity, Index Ventures, Tiger Global, Balderton Capital, and Y Combinator. Learn more at taktile.com.

About the Role

Taktile builds AI products for the world's most complex decisions and we hold ourselves to the same standard internally. We believe the companies that win the next decade will be the ones that turn AI from a tool into a multiplier - embedded into how every team works.

We're looking for an AI Enablement Lead to make this the reality at Taktile. This is a high-leverage, internal-facing operations role: you won't be building features for our customers, you'll be building the tools, integrations, and workflows that make every Taktilian faster and better at their job.

You'll be the first hire dedicated to this mission, working closely with team leads across the company to identify, build, and scale the AI workflows with the biggest impact. You'll be taking over a program that was set up internally and comes with support for infrastructure and agent-building. You will operate at both strategic and hands-on levels: setting the roadmap and reporting directly to leadership, while also building workflows and running enablement yourself.

Taktile is a hybrid company. This role requires working at least 3 days per week from one of our offices in Berlin, Iasi, or London.

What You'll Do

Strategy & Roadmap

  • Define and own Taktile's internal AI roadmap, prioritize use cases across Go-to-market, Operations, and G&A

  • Track market trends, peer practices, regulatory evolution, and emerging tools — stay on the frontier, know when new tools and models release, which ones are worth experimenting with, and bring the best back into the business

  • Continuously evaluate and improve our setup to maximize adoption and improve efficiency of our teams

  • Report to leadership on progress, AI adoption, and program ROI

  • Set the internal standard for "production-ready" AI workflows and act as the escalation point and quality bar for everything our teams ship

  • Define a build vs. buy framework for AI point solutions - assessing, approving, or deprecating tools in close collaboration with our teams

Agentic Workflow Development

  • Build internal tools and agents end-to-end that wire Taktile's SaaS stack (HubSpot, Notion, Linear, Gong) into our engineers' and operators' daily workflows. Own scope, design, implementation, rollout, and iteration.

  • Evolve AI architecture based on internal customer needs and tangible, measurable improvements.

  • Identify, prioritize, and scale automation opportunities across business units, while clearly differentiating what can and should be automated and to what degree vs. what should not (yet)

  • Find the highest-leverage workflows. Embed with teams across Engineering, GTM, Customer Success, Finance, and Operations to identify where AI can remove the most friction.

  • Build team-level ownership and coordinate a network of AI champions so workflows are maintained without central dependency

Capability Building & governance

  • Drive adoption, not just deployment. Run hands-on workshops, pair sessions, and office hours to teach teams how to actually use what you ship. Measure success in real adoption and time saved, not features delivered.

  • Partner with Security and IT on governance. Apply least-privilege principles from day one. Build the guardrails, access scoping, and audit trails that let us move fast on AI without exposing customer data or production systems.

What You'll Need

  • 5+ years in consulting, operations, or a similar cross-functional senior role

  • Ability to write and review production-grade Python and SQL - preferably with a strong technical background - e.g., Data Science

  • Technical deployment experience + hands-on experience building with modern LLM tooling - agent frameworks, tool use, prompt engineering, MCP, evals

  • Enough technical depth to converse about LLM pipelines, agentic workflows, and integrations

  • Excellence breaking down complex problems and making quick, well-informed decisions even under pressure

  • Strong program management skills across complex, multi-stakeholder environments

  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. Strong written and verbal communication skills from leadership reporting to internal playbooks - with both technical and non-technical operators alike

Our Stack

  • AI: Claude

  • Programming Language: Python

  • Data Platform: AWS, Snowflake, dbt, Terraform

  • Internal Tools: Notion, Linear, HubSpot, Gong, Ramp

What We Offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here.

  • Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early-stage company.

  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo.

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package.

  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

  • Use the equipment of your choice including meaningful home office set-up.

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply.

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears.

title: Data Engineer
description: As a Data Engineer at PERGOLUX , you will build and own the data pipelines that enable fast, reliable operational insights across the business. Your work ensures the company can trust its data, automate confidently, and make high-impact decisions in real time. At PERGOLUX , we combine Scandinavian-inspired design with a collaborative, ambitious culture grounded in integrity, innovation, and unity. title: Arzt/ Ärztin Campus Event Manager - DACH (Hybrid / Remote DE)
description: Hallo, wir von AMBOSS sind aktuell auf der Suche nach einer oder einem Arzt/ Ärztin Campus Event Manager:in in Vollzeit (Hybrid / Remote DE). Du hast vor kurzem dein Medizinstudium abgeschlossen oder bist kurz davor, du reist gerne, bist kommunikativ und hast Lust, dich aktiv in die Planung und Umsetzung von AMBOSS Uni Events mit einzubringen? Dann könnte diese Stelle genau das Richtige für dich sein! Warum AMBOSS? AMBOSS ist der Copilot für den medizinischen Alltag. Mit unserer Plattform unterstützen wir Fachkräfte bei der Fortbildung sowie bei klinischen Entscheidungen, um stets die bestmögliche Patientenversorgung zu gewährleisten. Unser Team vereint Fürsorge, innovative Ideen und modernste KI-basierte Medizintechnologie. Gegründet wurde AMBOSS 2012 von Ärztinnen und Ärzten, die genau das Tool entwickeln wollten, das ihnen im Studium und in der Klinik gefehlt hat. Seitdem sind wir auf über 600 Mitarbeitende gewachsen und in mehr als 180 Ländern aktiv, vor allem in Deutschland und den USA. Unsere Büros befinden sich in Berlin, Köln, New York, Cagliari, Cape Town und Kapstadt. Als Teil unseres DACH Campus Teams bist du das Gesicht von AMBOSS an den medizinischen Fakultäten. Du bist mittendrin, teilst dein Wissen und deine Erfahrungen mit Studierenden und kannst gleichzeitig deren Wünsche und Vorstellungen an das AMBOSS Team weitergeben. Du bist also die Schnittstelle zwischen denjenigen, die AMBOSS tagtäglich nutzen und denjenigen, die AMBOSS Tag für Tag noch besser machen. Möchtest du mehr über unsere Kultur erfahren? Schau dir unser Video an und entdecke, was uns einzigartig macht. Deine Aufgaben: Roadshow-Planung: Gemeinsam mit deinem Team entscheidest du, welche Unis wir besuchen. Du übernimmst die konkrete Planung und stehst im engen Austausch mit Unis, Fachschaften und unseren AMBOSS-Botschafter:innen. AMBOSS präsentieren: Du erstellst zielgruppengerechte Präsentationen und teilst vor Ort deine eigenen Erfahrungen. Du gibst den Studis Tipps zum Studienstart oder zum Physikum und zeigst ihnen, wie sie sich am besten mit AMBOSS vorbereiten. Projektentwicklung: Du planst eigeninitiativ neue Projekte und Events. Da du selbst gerade erst fertig studiert hast, weißt du genau, was gebraucht wird – bei uns hast du immer die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen umzusetzen. Analyse & Budget: Gemeinsam mit unserem Data Team erstellst du Analysen zur Budgetierung und wertest deine Projekte aus, um das Potenzial für Verbesserungen voll auszuschöpfen. Teamwork & Einblicke: Du arbeitest eng mit dem gesamten DACH Campus Team zusammen. Dabei blickst du über den Tellerrand und lernst viel über Projektmanagement, Marketing und B2B-Partnerships. Das Besondere: Feedback-Loop: Du bist direkt vor Ort und merkst sofort, was gut funktioniert und wo die Studis Unterstützung brauchen. Medimeisterschaften: Du fährst wieder hin! Diesmal aber als fester Teil unseres Teams. ;) Deine Fähigkeiten: Du hast dein Medizinstudium vor kurzem hinter dich gebracht oder bist kurz davor? Du kennst dich bestens mit den Funktionen von AMBOSS aus und greifst bei medizinischen Fragen häufig nach deinem Handy, um kurz bei AMBOSS nachzuschauen? Du bist ein Organisationstalent und behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn sich spontan die Umstände ändern? Du begeisterst gerne Menschen, hast vielleicht schon Erfahrungen als Tutor:in gesammelt und würdest gerne häufiger vorne im Hörsaal stehen? Du reist gerne und hast Lust, die verschiedenen Unis in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz kennenzulernen? Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und fühlst dich wohl im Englischen? Wir machen es kurz: Du bist ein AMBOSS-Fan, du organisierst gerne, fühlst dich im Uni-Umfeld zuhause und du hast Spaß daran, deine Erfahrungen mit Studis zu teilen? Dann suchen wir genau dich! Was ein Pluspunkt wäre: Du hast Spaß daran, Flyer, Postkarten, Sticker und was dir noch so einfällt mit zu designen. Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Projektmanagement oder Marketing gesammelt. Du bringst Grundkenntnisse in den Bereichen Projektbewertung, Budgetplanung und Datenanalyse mit. Benefits: AMBOSSSians erzählen uns, dass eine innovative Arbeit ihnen Antrieb gibt und sie sich durch Mitarbeiter-Benefits wertgeschätzt und in ihrer Arbeit bestärkt fühlen. Wir investieren in jeden AMBOSSian mit unseren Mitarbeiter-Benefits, die extra zugeschnitten wurden, um die finanzielle, physische und mentale Gesundheit zu unterstützen und zu einer positiven Work-Life-Balance beizutragen. 🌴 Erholung & Freizeit (30 bezahlte Urlaubstage, einen AMBOSS-Feiertag, ein persönlicher Purpose Day und mehr) 🥙 Verpflegung & Komfort (Täglich gesundes Frühstück und Mittagessen von unseren hauseigenen Küchenchefs im Berliner Büro, die AMBOSS-Kita, sowie die Möglichkeit, remote aus unseren Büros in Köln, Sardinien oder Kapstadt zu arbeiten) 🏃 Gesundheit & Mobilität (Urban Sports Club - M-Plan, Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland-Ticket und mehr) Erfahre hier mehr über unsere Benefit-Pakete: http://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt ein starker Motor für Innovation und Fortschritt ist. Deshalb engagieren wir uns für ein inklusives, respektvolles und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem alle Menschen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, ethnischer oder kultureller Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, sexueller Orientierung oder geschlechtlicher Identität – wertgeschätzt werden und die gleichen Chancen erhalten, ihr Potenzial zu entfalten. Wir heißen Menschen mit den unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen herzlich willkommen, uns bei unserer Mission zu unterstützen: medizinisches Fachpersonal dabei zu stärken und die bestmögliche Versorgung zu gewährleisten. Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen der Stellenbeschreibung erfüllst, ermutigen wir dich, dich zu bewerben. Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Warum AMBOSS?

AMBOSS ist der Copilot für den medizinischen Alltag. Mit unserer Plattform unterstützen wir Fachkräfte bei der Fortbildung sowie bei klinischen Entscheidungen, um stets die bestmögliche Patientenversorgung zu gewährleisten. Unser Team vereint Fürsorge, innovative Ideen und modernste KI-basierte Medizintechnologie. Gegründet wurde AMBOSS 2012 von Ärztinnen und Ärzten, die genau das Tool entwickeln wollten, das ihnen im Studium und in der Klinik gefehlt hat. Seitdem sind wir auf über 600 Mitarbeitende gewachsen und in mehr als 180 Ländern aktiv, vor allem in Deutschland und den USA. Unsere Büros befinden sich in Berlin, Köln, New York, Cagliari, Cape Town und Kapstadt.

Als Teil unseres DACH Campus Teams bist du das Gesicht von AMBOSS an den medizinischen Fakultäten. Du bist mittendrin, teilst dein Wissen und deine Erfahrungen mit Studierenden und kannst gleichzeitig deren Wünsche und Vorstellungen an das AMBOSS Team weitergeben. Du bist also die Schnittstelle zwischen denjenigen, die AMBOSS tagtäglich nutzen und denjenigen, die AMBOSS Tag für Tag noch besser machen.

Möchtest du mehr über unsere Kultur erfahren? Schau dir unser Video an und entdecke, was uns einzigartig macht.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Roadshow-Planung: Gemeinsam mit deinem Team entscheidest du, welche Unis wir besuchen. Du übernimmst die konkrete Planung und stehst im engen Austausch mit Unis, Fachschaften und unseren AMBOSS-Botschafter:innen.

  • AMBOSS präsentieren: Du erstellst zielgruppengerechte Präsentationen und teilst vor Ort deine eigenen Erfahrungen. Du gibst den Studis Tipps zum Studienstart oder zum Physikum und zeigst ihnen, wie sie sich am besten mit AMBOSS vorbereiten.

  • Projektentwicklung: Du planst eigeninitiativ neue Projekte und Events. Da du selbst gerade erst fertig studiert hast, weißt du genau, was gebraucht wird – bei uns hast du immer die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen umzusetzen.

  • Analyse & Budget: Gemeinsam mit unserem Data Team erstellst du Analysen zur Budgetierung und wertest deine Projekte aus, um das Potenzial für Verbesserungen voll auszuschöpfen.

  • Teamwork & Einblicke: Du arbeitest eng mit dem gesamten DACH Campus Team zusammen. Dabei blickst du über den Tellerrand und lernst viel über Projektmanagement, Marketing und B2B-Partnerships.

Das Besondere:

  • Feedback-Loop: Du bist direkt vor Ort und merkst sofort, was gut funktioniert und wo die Studis Unterstützung brauchen.

  • Medimeisterschaften: Du fährst wieder hin! Diesmal aber als fester Teil unseres Teams. ;)

Deine Fähigkeiten:

  • Du hast dein Medizinstudium vor kurzem hinter dich gebracht oder bist kurz davor?

  • Du kennst dich bestens mit den Funktionen von AMBOSS aus und greifst bei medizinischen Fragen häufig nach deinem Handy, um kurz bei AMBOSS nachzuschauen?

  • Du bist ein Organisationstalent und behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn sich spontan die Umstände ändern?

  • Du begeisterst gerne Menschen, hast vielleicht schon Erfahrungen als Tutor:in gesammelt und würdest gerne häufiger vorne im Hörsaal stehen?

  • Du reist gerne und hast Lust, die verschiedenen Unis in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz kennenzulernen?

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und fühlst dich wohl im Englischen?

  • Wir machen es kurz: Du bist ein AMBOSS-Fan, du organisierst gerne, fühlst dich im Uni-Umfeld zuhause und du hast Spaß daran, deine Erfahrungen mit Studis zu teilen? Dann suchen wir genau dich!

Was ein Pluspunkt wäre:

  • Du hast Spaß daran, Flyer, Postkarten, Sticker und was dir noch so einfällt mit zu designen.

  • Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Projektmanagement oder Marketing gesammelt.

  • Du bringst Grundkenntnisse in den Bereichen Projektbewertung, Budgetplanung und Datenanalyse mit.

Benefits:

AMBOSSSians erzählen uns, dass eine innovative Arbeit ihnen Antrieb gibt und sie sich durch Mitarbeiter-Benefits wertgeschätzt und in ihrer Arbeit bestärkt fühlen. Wir investieren in jeden AMBOSSian mit unseren Mitarbeiter-Benefits, die extra zugeschnitten wurden, um die finanzielle, physische und mentale Gesundheit zu unterstützen und zu einer positiven Work-Life-Balance beizutragen.

🌴 Erholung & Freizeit (30 bezahlte Urlaubstage, einen AMBOSS-Feiertag, ein persönlicher Purpose Day und mehr)

🥙 Verpflegung & Komfort (Täglich gesundes Frühstück und Mittagessen von unseren hauseigenen Küchenchefs im Berliner Büro, die AMBOSS-Kita, sowie die Möglichkeit, remote aus unseren Büros in Köln, Sardinien oder Kapstadt zu arbeiten)

🏃 Gesundheit & Mobilität (Urban Sports Club - M-Plan, Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland-Ticket und mehr)

Erfahre hier mehr über unsere Benefit-Pakete:

http://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt ein starker Motor für Innovation und Fortschritt ist. Deshalb engagieren wir uns für ein inklusives, respektvolles und unterstützendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem alle Menschen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, ethnischer oder kultureller Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, sexueller Orientierung oder geschlechtlicher Identität – wertgeschätzt werden und die gleichen Chancen erhalten, ihr Potenzial zu entfalten.

Wir heißen Menschen mit den unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen herzlich willkommen, uns bei unserer Mission zu unterstützen: medizinisches Fachpersonal dabei zu stärken und die bestmögliche Versorgung zu gewährleisten.

Auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen der Stellenbeschreibung erfüllst, ermutigen wir dich, dich zu bewerben. Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören!

description: The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The Team It's still difficult for business owners to sell their business, or buy others, in the sub-£10m enterprise value market. Information asymmetry, lack of knowledge, and low transaction amounts make it hard, and most M&A firms shy away from the segment because they can't serve it profitably. manda fixes this: leveraging iwoca's deep footprint in the SME economy, with 150,000+ UK customers, and our ability to build clean, efficient, automated processes, we're building the only M&A platform in the UK. We match buyers with sellers across three channels we already run: inbound from iwoca's SME base, automated outbound to vendors matching live buyer mandates, and referrals from our buy-side pipeline. And we're piloting acquisition finance through iwoca so buyers arrive pre-qualified and often pre-financed. You'll join an early-stage venture with the autonomy and pace of a startup, backed by the data, infrastructure, and credibility of an established lender. You'll work directly with the Venture Lead and alongside our Deal Team of buy-side and sell-side Transaction Managers to define, validate, and scale the product. The role As a Product Strategy Analyst, you'll sit at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and product, with the autonomy to find, scope and prototype, and thus shaping how manda evolves. You'll own projects end-to-end, from insight and validation through to launch and iteration. Scoping the operating system and customer journey Translate operational reality into precise product specs: observe how the Deal Team actually closes deals and turn that into detailed scopes the Product Builder can build from, defining the variables, states, triggers, and mechanics of each workflow (e.g. our HubSpot automation and the systems that run the business day to day). Dissect the complex M&A process into smaller structures, then scope each part for the Product Builder to digitise, automate and optimise, with clear logic, edge cases, and acceptance criteria rather than vague requirements. Scope the customer journey across our channels end to end, specifying each step and decision point so we can systematically reduce friction for buyers and sellers, from first contact through to a closed deal. Analysis and experimentation Design and run experiments to validate new product concepts, building lightweight prototypes yourself and iterating on customer feedback and performance data. Combine quantitative analysis with qualitative insight to find friction and unlock growth, building the data pipelines and monitoring the team needs to track product performance post-launch. Leadership, collaboration and influence Work closely with the Product Builder and operations to turn ideas into shipped products, prioritising based on the raw friction of closing deals. Distill complex market dynamics into clear, actionable recommendations for the Venture Lead and iwoca's leadership, then take ownership of the decisions that follow. The requirements Essential: A commercial thinker with a bias for action who is comfortable navigating ambiguity in an early-stage venture. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous business problems and translate complex data into clear, actionable insights. Ability to understand operational reality and translate it into detailed, unambiguous scopes, with defined variables and mechanics, that turn into functional, automated systems, whether that's our HubSpot automation or internal tooling. Strong capability using AI tools, including structured prompting and iterative interaction, to test ideas quickly and articulate clear product thinking, turning intent into execution with speed and precision. You'll have the mental rigour to validate, audit, and refine AI-generated outputs. Comfortable building lightweight prototypes yourself, using AI and low-code tools, to test and validate concepts before handing detailed scopes to the Product Builder. Bonus: 2–3 years' experience at an M&A platform, online marketplace, or tech-enabled M&A business, ideally in a strategy, product, or analytics role where you used data to inform commercially meaningful decisions. Experience with Python and SQL for data analysis, or BI platforms like Looker. A strong academic background (Economics, Business, Finance, Engineering, or another quantitative/STEM discipline). The culture At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective. We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them. You will be reporting to Mike Hook (the ‘Product Builder’) who is responsible for building the Manda product. Your centre of gravity is product strategy, idea generation, insight, and M&A expertise, complementing the Product Builder who owns the technical build.

  • Take a big-picture view of the whole M&A journey: map the long, complex process end to end, pressure-test manda's value proposition against it, and find where the experience, the economics, or the data we collect can be improved.

  • Shape manda's value proposition by monitoring M&A service models across the UK SME economy and beyond, from listing platforms to traditional advisory firms, including their fee structures, matching processes, and mandate acquisition channels.


Scoping the operating system and customer journey

  • Translate operational reality into precise product specs: observe how the Deal Team actually closes deals and turn that into detailed scopes the Product Builder can build from, defining the variables, states, triggers, and mechanics of each workflow (e.g. our HubSpot automation and the systems that run the business day to day).

  • Dissect the complex M&A process into smaller structures, then scope each part for the Product Builder to digitise, automate and optimise, with clear logic, edge cases, and acceptance criteria rather than vague requirements.

  • Scope the customer journey across our channels end to end, specifying each step and decision point so we can systematically reduce friction for buyers and sellers, from first contact through to a closed deal.

Analysis and experimentation

  • Design and run experiments to validate new product concepts, building lightweight prototypes yourself and iterating on customer feedback and performance data.

  • Combine quantitative analysis with qualitative insight to find friction and unlock growth, building the data pipelines and monitoring the team needs to track product performance post-launch.

An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the world's first unified payment infrastructure, founded by former leaders of Braintree and PayPal. We unify fragmented payment and finance systems into a single, intelligent platform, automating the entire payments lifecycle from acceptance and orchestration to reconciliation, FX, and financial operations.

Trusted by leading merchants worldwide, we give finance, payments, and engineering teams the tools to move faster, reduce complexity, and unlock growth. Our open, modular platform connects to 150+ services across the payments ecosystem, while our expanding CFO product suite brings unified reconciliation, FX management, and financial visibility across markets and currencies.

Backed by Accel, Balderton, ICONIQ, and Tencent, we're setting a new standard for how the world moves money.

What will the role involve?

  • Design and deliver end-to-end product experiences — from low-fi sketches to high-fidelity prototypes

  • Validate design decisions through both qualitative and quantitative research methods

  • Collaborate with PMs, engineers, and wider teams to solve complex problems using first principles thinking

  • Craft simple, accessible, and visually polished experiences that put the user first

  • Champion and contribute to our design system to ensure consistency and scalability

  • Work closely with engineers to bring designs to life — balancing polish with pragmatism

  • Facilitate workshops and design thinking sessions to unlock ideas and align teams

  • Thrive in a fast-moving, highly collaborative product environment

What are we looking for?

  • Experience owning and driving product design solutions

  • Strong understanding of best practices for turning complex flows into intuitive experiences

  • Sensitivity to user needs — backed by enthusiasm for testing and data

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across product and engineering

  • Data-informed mindset — confident using analytics, A/B testing, and insights to guide decisions

  • Experience contributing to and maintaining a design system

  • Skilled at facilitating workshops and engaging stakeholders in the design process

  • Curious, creative, and eager to grow in a high-performing design team

🚫 You may not like it here if:

  • You enjoy working in an office setting; we are remote-first and always will be!

  • You are not comfortable with shifting context and navigating ambiguity

✅ A typical interview process

  • An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

  • An interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role

  • A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?


We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone.

Our benefits

🌍 We are fully remote and globally distributed; and have been since day one
💰 Competitive share options
🌴 Uncapped holiday, with 25 days minimum to be taken
🗣️ Co-working space access across major cities
📅 Workations & Company Retreat
💻 The best equipment for your role
🏠 £500 towards your home office setup
🔎 Generous learning budget
🏥 Private Medical Insurance
📈 A broad set of additional perks and benefits (depending on location)

Don’t meet every single requirement?

At Primer, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Own Primer's GTM intelligence layer Maintain and continuously improve the dashboards and data models at the core of how our GTM teams operate and make decisions. You'll identify gaps, build new views, and ensure the data our teams rely on is accurate, trusted, and acted upon - not just looked at. Keep the AI in our BI sharp Continuously train and improve our BI tool’s (Omni) AI model so that natural-language queries, whether through Omni directly or via Claude, return accurate, contextually aware results. You are the steward of how well our BI tool thinks. Identify where missing data sources are limiting GTM intelligence and work with the data engineering team to build the pipelines that close those gaps. You understand the data landscape end-to-end and can make a clear case for what needs to be optimised or built. Surface pipeline and account intelligence Build models and dashboards that go beyond historical reporting - surfacing engagement signals, account health indicators, and expansion opportunities that help GTM reps prioritise the right actions at the right time. Partner with data engineering and product ops to embed analytic events across Primer's web and dashboard environments, capturing user and intent signals that bring a new layer of behavioural intelligence into GTM. Model Salesforce data correctly Ensure CRM data is well-structured, correctly modelled, and fully leveraged in reporting. Work with RevOps and GTM leadership to make sure what lives in Salesforce is trusted, clean, and meaningful, so that any reporting built on top of it actually reflects reality. Own the GTM data foundation Define and maintain field definitions, naming conventions, and data quality standards across the GTM tech stack. Good AI starts with good data, and good data starts with clear governance. You'll build and curate the GTM knowledge base that sits behind our AI. Build GTM AI workflows, with Claude at the core Work with GTM stakeholders, and Primer’s AI Strategy & Enablement Lead to spot processes where in-house AI workflows, skills and artifacts unlock real self-serve value. Build the more complex workflows hands-on, and upskill others to build the simpler ones themselves. Own adoption and impact, not just the build Shipping something is the start, not the finish. You own the rollout until it sticks, partnering with GTM Enablement on training and documentation so it lands inside existing enablement programmes rather than as a one-off. Collect feedback, iterate, and track and report on GTM AI use cases and their measurable impact. Promote self-serve data literacy Coach GTM stakeholders to explore data autonomously. Build the education and support that turns Omni from something people request help with into something they reach for themselves. Strong understanding of APIs and MCPs You know how to retrieve data from APIs, trigger actions via them, and think in terms of integrations. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you're comfortable operating at the boundary between data and tooling. High autonomy in ambiguous environments You don't wait for the problem to be fully defined. Ensure CRM data is well-structured, correctly modelled, and fully leveraged in reporting. Work with RevOps and GTM leadership to make sure what lives in Salesforce is trusted, clean, and meaningful, so that any reporting built on top of it actually reflects reality.

Build models that drive revenue decisions
Partner with RevOps to develop data models that calculate potential ROI for prospects evaluating Primer products, and build the forecasting infrastructure that improves the accuracy of payment volume and revenue projections.

Own the GTM data foundation
Define and maintain field definitions, naming conventions, and data quality standards across the GTM tech stack. Good AI starts with good data, and good data starts with clear governance.

Build the AI context layer for GTM
Create and maintain the shared knowledge infrastructure that gives AI tools, including Claude, the right context to produce high-quality outputs. You'll build and curate the GTM knowledge base that sits behind our AI.

Build GTM AI workflows, with Claude at the core
Work with GTM stakeholders, and Primer’s AI Strategy & Enablement Lead to spot processes where in-house AI workflows, skills and artifacts unlock real self-serve value. Build the more complex workflows hands-on, and upskill others to build the simpler ones themselves. Since Claude is central to AI at Primer, this includes enabling connectors to key business tools and building the skills that make Claude genuinely useful in a GTM role.

Own adoption and impact, not just the build
Shipping something is the start, not the finish. You own the rollout until it sticks, partnering with GTM Enablement on training and documentation so it lands inside existing enablement programmes rather than as a one-off. Collect feedback, iterate, and track and report on GTM AI use cases and their measurable impact.

Promote self-serve data literacy
Coach GTM stakeholders to explore data autonomously. Build the education and support that turns Omni from something people request help with into something they reach for themselves.

Stay ahead of the AI landscape
Proactively assess new AI tools and new features in Primer's existing tech stack. Make clear recommendations on what to adopt, pilot, or ignore. Ensure we're extracting full value from what we already pay for.

raw.description:
An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

Which team will you be joining?

Product at Primer owns the systems that move money for some of the most demanding merchants in the world. We are building payments infrastructure that has to be correct, resilient and fast, in a space where the edge cases are the job, not an afterthought.

We are hiring Senior PMs across numerous teams. Wherever you land, you will own a full product area: a coherent space made up of several related problems, with outcomes that persist over quarters and years rather than a single initiative. You set the direction for that area, decide what gets solved and what deliberately does not, and own how success is measured.

You will report into our VP of Product and work day to day with a dedicated engineering team and design partner, alongside GTM, RevOps and Product Marketing. Primer is remote-first and globally distributed, and always will be. We run on written thinking, low bureaucracy and real ownership. You build it, you own it, end to end.

What will you be doing?

  • Owning the strategy and outcomes for your product area, translating company objectives into a multi-quarter plan and clear guardrails for what you will and will not build

  • Resolving genuine ambiguity with evidence and judgment, not waiting for someone to hand you a brief or a roadmap

  • Running discovery and an ongoing insight system for your area: research cadence, merchant and GTM feedback loops, and competitive monitoring that actually changes decisions

  • Working closely with engineering on implementation, architecture and long-term technical direction, not just handing over specs

  • Setting GTM direction for your area, including positioning and pricing input, in partnership with RevOps and Product Marketing

  • Making sophisticated trade-offs across scope, quality and timing, protecting long-term technical health rather than only this quarter's delivery

  • Raising the quality of product thinking around you through clear decision documentation, reusable playbooks and the example you set under pressure

  • Acting as a credible product voice with senior internal stakeholders and directly with key merchants

What we're looking for

Must-haves:

  • A track record of owning a product area or substantial problem space end to end, where the outcomes can be traced back to your judgment and execution

  • Strong product judgment in ambiguous, high-stakes situations, with the ability to explain your reasoning clearly

  • Comfort working deeply with engineers on technical and architectural trade-offs, enough fluency to be a real partner rather than a translator

  • Evidence-led decision making: you use data, research and merchant input to decide, and you know when the evidence is thin

  • The ability to influence senior stakeholders and align conflicting interests without relying on authority

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience in payments, fintech or another complex, regulated or infrastructure domain

  • Experience building or improving the systems and rituals a product team runs on

You may not like it here

  • You are expected to set the strategy for your area, including what not to build. If you do your best work executing a plan someone else owns, this is not the role.

  • We are remote-first and async by default. If you need people physically around you, or real-time availability to feel productive, this is a real adjustment, not a perk.

  • Context and priorities shift as we learn. You will sometimes change direction on work you were attached to, and you need to be able to do that without it derailing you.

  • Feedback here is direct, frequent and not softened. You are expected to give it as well as take it.

✅ A typical interview process

  • An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

  • An interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role

  • A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?


We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone.

raw.description:
An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

What team will you be joining?

A Primer payment is worth so much more than a regular payment.

In the Orchestration team we build the engine that powers intelligent, seamless, and reliable payments — across any provider, method, or market. We own the full orchestration layer: routing decisions, fallback logic, and the smart infrastructure that makes every payment perform at its best.

This team covers everything from checkout and payment processing through to tokenization, authentication, fallback logic, developer tooling, and workflows.

 

What will you be doing?

  • Lead a cross-functional team spanning frontend, mobile and backend, helping engineers grow beyond their original specialism and supporting them as they pick up unfamiliar parts of the stack

  • Own a defined area of software architecture, taking responsibility for delivery, quality, and technical direction

  • Run an effective development process: sprint health, delivery cadence, incident response, postmortems, and a sustainable on-call rotation that doesn't burn people out

  • Grow the engineers on your team through regular feedback, performance conversations, and stretch assignments that actually move people forward

  • Work closely with product to scope initiatives, identify risks, and prioritise deliverables, giving clear heads-up when capacity is constrained

  • Stay close enough to your team's technical work to ask the right questions, spot risks early, and contribute meaningfully to design discussions without becoming a bottleneck

  • Define the right metrics for your team's systems, use them to explain performance, catch variance, and drive improvements before they become incidents

  • Handle the difficult conversations, whether that's performance issues, interpersonal friction, or delivery risk, before they become problems that need escalating


What we're looking for

  • Comfortable leading a cross-functional team. Either you've managed engineers across frontend, mobile and backend before, or you're genuinely open to it and to ramping up on the parts of the stack you know less well

  • A background as a software engineer, with hands-on experience building and shipping production systems. This is a hard requirement.

  • Experience managing a team of engineers, with a track record of building effective development processes and growing individual contributors

  • Technically credible enough to evaluate design decisions, challenge assumptions, and be taken seriously by strong engineers, without needing to be the most technical person in the room

  • Comfortable with operational ownership: on-call culture, incident management, postmortems, and the unglamorous work of keeping systems healthy

  • Clear, direct communication with stakeholders and leadership, including knowing when and how to escalate and when not to

  • Able to operate with meaningful autonomy: you don't need a playbook for every situation, but you know when to ask for one

Nice to have:

  • Direct experience managing full-stack or cross-functional teams across both frontend and backend

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or a similarly regulated and high-stakes technical domain

  • Familiarity with distributed systems and the trade-offs that come with high-throughput, high-availability infrastructure

✅ A typical interview process

  • An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

  • An interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role

  • A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?


We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand. Job Description Most agencies are still debating where AI belongs in delivery. We have already rebuilt it. Our technical search and GEO practice runs on agentic workflows we built ourselves, and the question in front of us is no longer whether to automate but how far and how fast we push it. This role accelerates that on two fronts. Inside Jellyfish, you will extend a live agentic delivery stack and aim it at harder problems. Outside, you will do the same for the enterprise brands you work with, helping them build the technical foundations and the working practices that a market run by agents demands. It takes a serious SEO background. You cannot automate a process you have never run yourself, and you cannot set the bar for what an agent produces unless you know what a good deliverable looks like. You will be in front of clients constantly, but you are not the account lead. Your output is capability, ours and theirs. Your main responsibilities will include: Agentic delivery inside Jellyfish Where our agentic delivery goes next, and the judgement on what gets automated, what stays assisted and what should remain human The build itself. Hands-on across tool APIs and MCP servers, AI harnesses and agentic operating systems, not a role briefing someone else to do it Adoption across the practice. The measure of a build is how quickly it becomes the default way the work gets done The pace. We are ahead of the market on this and intend to stay there Agentic adoption with clients The client-side agenda. Getting enterprise brands ready for a market where agents research, compare and transact on behalf of their customers The technical foundations that decide whether a brand can participate at all, from agent access through to machine readable commerce Helping client teams adopt agentic ways of working themselves, rather than only consuming ours Carrying the argument at senior client level, where the case for moving still has to be made The technical standard Expert authority on enterprise technical search across large, complex estates What good looks like. You define the deliverable standard the agentic layer has to meet, across audits, migrations, roadmaps and reporting The quality bar for what agentic delivery is allowed to conclude, and the review standard sitting in front of anything client facing The technical approach to how brands are retrieved, cited and represented by AI, treated as a structural problem rather than a copy problem Entity and knowledge graph strategy, and the machine access layer beneath it Credibility at the infrastructure layer, where architecture, edge configuration and crawler access determine what is even possible Working authority across the frontier model landscape and how retrieval and citation behaviour differs between engines The evidence Proof of what agentic delivery returns, measured in capacity, throughput and quality held The measurement frameworks connecting technical and AI visibility work to commercial outcomes, ours and our clients' A testing approach that produces evidence rather than opinion Honest reporting, including retiring automations that have not earned their place What you'll bring Essential 8+ years in SEO with deep enterprise experience across the full delivery cycle, from technical audits and migrations through to roadmaps, briefing and reporting. You have run this work yourself, at pace, to client standard Enough technical depth on large, complex estates to judge whether an automated output is right or subtly wrong, and to know the difference on sight Real experience building agentic or AI assisted workflows that replaced manual work and were adopted. We will ask what you built, what it replaced, and who uses it now Working knowledge of Python and APIs. Not an engineer, but someone who builds rather than specifies and waits Practical GEO capability treated as a technical discipline rather than a content exercise The ability to change how experienced people work, inside our teams and inside our clients'. That is the harder half of this job Credibility with senior client stakeholders, including making the case for change to people who did not ask for it Thorough experience with reporting and measurement frameworks. You have designed them rather than populated them, you can defend a methodology under scrutiny, and you can prove an automated output holds up against a human one Exposure to the leading enterprise SEO and visibility toolsets, and the judgement to know when a platform's data is directionally wrong Comfort with autonomy and pace. This discipline moves faster than any playbook, including ours Desirable Agency or other multi client experience, where process variance across accounts is the enemy Retail or ecommerce at enterprise scale, and familiarity with the platform constraints that come with it Exposure to AI visibility and generative search measurement tooling Working knowledge of agentic commerce standards and how they intersect with product discovery Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. Number one on the FT1000, number one on the Sifted 100. From £1m to over £100m in under three years, with a small, talent-dense team and an electric culture with day one founder intensity. Now we're aiming for £1bn in the next three.

We curate the world's best wellbeing brands across The Four Pillars™: EAT, MOVE, MIND, SLEEP. That's the first chapter.

The next chapter is harder and more interesting.

We are moving from one market to many, from e-commerce to a technology platform, and from curating wellbeing to defining it. We are a health company, so we think we should act like one.

At its fullest expression, Healf redefines what wellbeing means for tens of millions of people.

Accelerated Operator Programme: Talent and Performance

It is another Monday and you already know which of the new analysts is going to be great.

You always know. In every team you have been on, you could tell within a week who was exceptional and who was merely polished. Who had more in their locker than their CV showed. You read people the way other people read the news.

Nobody has ever paid you for it. It is the most valuable thing you do.

Here is the role most exceptional operators never think to want.

It has the word talent in the title, so it reads like a sideways step into HR, into process, into the back office. That instinct is wrong here, and expensively so. Every person who ever builds this company walks through one door, and you stand beside it. You decide who comes in. Few seats in any business let one person shape what the whole thing becomes this directly, and fewer still where the work is this human. It is the most consequential doorway we have, and quietly one of the most fulfilling.

Why this programme is Healf

Healf is building Wellbeing Intelligence, a system that learns what makes people well, for whom, and why, from the behaviour of half a million people. The hardest part of that work is inference: reading early, noisy signal and predicting a human outcome before it is visible.

Finding extraordinary people is the same problem.

A conversation, a piece of writing, the way someone learns something new in a day. Weak signal, a delayed outcome, every confounder in the world. The market waits for the proof: the McKinsey badge, the Goldman programme, the stamp that says they are exceptional. By the time it arrives, everyone is bidding for the same person. We read the qualities directly, before the stamp, and we are building the company best placed in Europe to make that reading a discipline.

This is not a recruiting seat. It is applied human-performance research, pointed at the most consequential capital Healf allocates: who is inside the building.

 

The work

You join the performance function from day one, the small R&D engine designing the systems, science and standards that bring exceptional people to Healf and unlock high performance once they are here. You work alongside the UK Talent Lead, the Head of Performance Science and the Human Performance Lead.

→ Frontier scouting. Healf has mapped the most concentrated talent pools in the world, the places where membership alone is a credible signal. Stripe alumni looking for the next chapter. DeepMind researchers who want to apply their work to wellbeing. Olympic athletes in transition who already understand high performance. You learn the pools, build relationships inside them, and bring forward the people who change the trajectory.

→ Building the recognition engine. Not one hire at a time. The system. The proactive pipelines, the warm community of vetted people that hiring managers draw from when a seat opens, the assessment built on the Healf Standard so the judgement is consistent across the team. You turn instinct into something repeatable.

→ The careers and community brand. The surface ambitious people see and feel before they apply. Distinctive, wellbeing-literate, unmistakably Healf. You make Healf the obvious choice for the next person before they have started looking.

→ Performance, not only hiring. You own the arc from first conversation to high performer. Bringing extraordinary people in is half the job. The other half is making sure they become the people we bet on. You show up in the moments that shape it: induction, calibration, goal-setting, the leadership programmes, and you help build the culture that makes the arc work.

 

The hire that shapes every other hire

Every other hire adds one exceptional person. This seat adds the function that adds all of them.

A great engineer ships great products. A great scout ships great engineers, great operators, and the next great scout. The output is more of the input. Get this seat wrong and every hire after it is slightly worse. Get it right and the talent density of the whole company compounds upward, year after year.

There is a reason founders who understand talent spend more time on the person who finds people than on almost anyone else. This is that person.

 

What you will have built in a year

→ A live pipeline of extraordinary people from frontier firms, elite labs and unconventional backgrounds who already know Healf and want in

→ Critical hires filled with people who raised the bar, in days rather than months

→ The first working version of a system that reads potential before the proof exists

→ A careers and community brand that makes the next exceptional person choose Healf before they have started looking

→ A track record inside the performance function you can point to and say: I did that

→ The beginning of a genuine ownership stake in one of the fastest-growing companies in Europe

How fast? Your first scouted hire should be in the building before most companies would have written the job spec.

 

Why you're Healf

You cannot stop reading people. It is not a professional skill you switched on. It is how you have always moved through the world. You notice who is exceptional before anyone tells you, and you are usually right.

You chose the hardest path available and excelled. Consulting, banking, law, or somewhere with a comparable bar. You got in because you are exceptional and you performed once you were there. That foundation is real and we take it seriously. The instinct that made you pick the hardest thing is the same instinct bringing you here.

You are on the front foot. You build, you do not wait. Half your week is reaching people who do not yet know they want to work at Healf. The pace that frustrated you in your last role is the pace this one demands.

You can write, and you can move someone with a story. Not in a marketing way. You can make a brilliant person who has three better-known offers stop and reconsider, because you understood what they wanted before they said it.

You are curious about AI beyond the headlines. You have used the tools because you wanted to see what was possible. You do not need to be technical. You need to want to build the engine, not just work the phones.

Wellbeing is personal. You track your sleep, you think about what you eat, you want to understand what works. Healf is not a market to you. The idea of finding the people who build it feels obvious.

 

Signals we're looking for

→ One person you identified or backed whose potential you saw before anyone else did. What did you see, why did you see it, and what happened?

→ Evidence you reached someone who was not looking, through means that were not a job board or an inbound application. You spotted them, you reached them, you won them.

→ A moment where you moved faster than the system around you allowed, and it mattered.

→ Something you built or shipped outside your job description because you saw it needed doing.

→ Something that tells us people and potential are an obsession, not a recent interest. How you talk about the people around you will tell us more than your CV.

The Deal

We ask a great deal of the people who work here. We expect full ownership and a genuine commitment to give this chapter everything you have.

In return, we will give you the same: everything we have, invested in your growth, your wellbeing, and the defining skills of the next decade.

We have built the fastest-growing company in Europe with a team small enough that every person in it shapes the outcome. That is still true today. The next person we hire will change the trajectory of the company.

If the most important work of your career is ahead of you, this is the place to do it.

This is the role that answers those questions.

What you'll own

  • The product, from first principles. You will define what Wellbeing Intelligence looks and feels like as a lived experience. The mobile app. The core surfaces. The information architecture. The emotional register. Not by inheriting a brief, but by thinking from the user’s life inward. What does it feel like to be someone who wants to be well and doesn’t know where to start? Start there. Research it. Frame it. Design it. Defend it.

  • The design system, from scratch. Components, patterns, standards. You will build the foundation that every designer and engineer after you builds on. Decisions made in the first six months will hold at ten times the scale. Overbuild for a future that hasn’t arrived yet and you slow the company down. Underbuild and you create chaos. Get it right.

  • The language and culture of design at Healf. How does Healf feel as a digital experience? Clinical or warm? Minimal or rich? Expert or approachable? You are ambitious. Not about titles. About the work. You want to look back at this chapter and know that what you built changed how people think about their health.

The Deal

Behind the leap from £1m to £100m — and the one we're planning next — sits a finance function that turns ambition into numbers we can stand behind. As Healf moves from e-commerce into a technology platform, the cost base gets bigger, and the decisions get sharper. This is where you come in. Role Purpose As Healf scales internationally and operates multiple regions and business units, disciplined control of operating costs, capital expenditure, and cash- related balances becomes critical to financial integrity and performance. This role exists to own the financial control, reporting, and forecasting of OPEX and CAPEX within management accounts, ensuring costs are accurately recorded, well understood, and tightly controlled. In parallel, the role acts as a finance business partner to cost centre owners, supporting planning, forecasting, and decision-making while maintaining strong control standards. The Management Accountant – OPEX & CAPEX Control sits firmly within Financial Control, working closely with Commercial Finance, the People team, and the Finance Systems & Data Lead to ensure cost and headcount data is accurate, consistent, and scalable. Core responsibilities OPEX & CAPEX Financial Control - Own the financial control and reporting of OPEX and CAPEX across all cost centres and functions. Ensure costs are accurately coded, accrued, reviewed, and reflected in management accounts. Maintain robust cost centre structures and enforce consistent application across the business. OPEX & CAPEX Planning, Forecasting & Partnering - Own OPEX and CAPEX planning and forecasting at cost centre level, partnering with Commercial Finance to ensure forecasts are grounded in actuals and optimise our capital allocation. Partner with cost centre owners to explain variances, challenge assumptions, and support efficient cost management. CAPEX Financial Control & Reporting - Own CAPEX accounting, reporting, and related balance sheet positions, including asset registers, depreciation, and reconciliations. Ensure capital spend is accurately recorded, aligned to approvals, and reflected correctly in management accounts. People Cost & Headcount Control - Own financial control and reporting of people costs at cost centre level. Partner with the People team to ensure payroll and headcount data is accurate, controlled, and aligned to management accounts. Provide reliable people cost actuals and forecasts to feed headcount reporting and the forecast owned by Commercial Finance. Systems-First Cost Control - Apply a systems-first mindset to OPEX and CAPEX control, prioritising automated posting, accruals, and reporting over manual workarounds. Work closely with the Finance Systems & Data Lead to ensure cost centre structures, planning logic, and reporting are embedded in systems. Interface with Commercial Finance - Provide accurate, timely OPEX, CAPEX, and people cost inputs to Commercial Finance.
